text:
elaine_sales: Quick heads-up — Orchid Retail just escalated to execs. CISO says KMS BYO required + they want a throughput guarantee for peak shopping hours. Finance also needs a capex-style pricing option by EOD. Can someone from infra + legal own this please? cc @sam_solutions @deepak_eng @karen_legal @maria_prod :exclamation:

sam_solutions: I can lead the infra side, happy to sync. Need clarity on the expected TPS and acceptable latency SLOs. Do we have their traffic profile?

elaine_sales: They sent a spreadsheet, but it's messy. Quick summary from the call: peak sessions ~12k/min, average request size small (chat queries), 95th p90 latency target ~150ms. I'll drop the sheet in the thread.

deepak_eng: Heads-up — current dedicated config can hit ~10k/min with KV-cache warm. For 12k we either add a small burst pool or use an autoscale window. Also need to know if they insist on hardware KMS (HSM) vs cloud KMS.

karen_legal: I saw the CISO ask. Orchids' legal team wants an addendum around key custody + audit logs. We'll need a DPA amendment + attestation for our key rotation policy. I can draft language but need the KMS provider details.

maria_prod: I'll book a 30-min sync at 4pm PT with Orchids' sec/infra folks and our infra + legal. Can everyone make it? If not, delegate.

sam_solutions: I can do 4pm. deepak — can you prepare an ops note with two options (autoscale burst vs reserved pool) and the delta cost? Put numbers in a quick table we can share with finance.

deepak_eng: Will do. ETA 2:30pm. Also: for HSM we'd need Private deployment (customer managed) or a Dedicated VPC with KMS peering — that'll change timeline and cost.

jamie_se: From pricing ops — capex option is possible for a committed reserved pool. I can model a 12-month capex with amortized units and show OPEX-equivalent. Need the delta cost output from @sam_solutions/deepak_eng.

ops_bot: Incident ticket created: INC-37821 — "Orchid Retail exec escalation: KMS + throughput asks". Pager oncall assigned: infra-team.

elaine_sales: Thanks everyone. Action items: (1) deepak: ops note + numeric capacity options by 2:30pm, (2) sam: cost delta table for reserved vs burst, (3) karen: draft DPA addendum + list of required KMS attestation fields, (4) jamie: capex model template, (5) maria: host 4pm PT sync and send calendar invite. I'll coordinate with customer to confirm time. Please post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
